I posted the handover bullets in #central-team. They come from the 9 June thread in that channel, so I can't say whether either item has been fixed since.

- **Eastbank door-label mismatch:** The ticket is PD-4821. The receiving-door import labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. It needs sorting before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates. Hollis owns setup and support on this.
- **Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift:** The morning receiver's appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and his trailer number went on a sticky note. Hollis was checking the shift template and asking support to reproduce it. I found no ticket number for this one, so the note doesn't give one.

I also added a caveat from the thread: no store should be marked "ready" until someone has made a test booking in the calendar. The post asks you to check whether either item has been fixed since June.
